user.title: Add a DDP pixel controller
user.description: Enter the controller's address. Home Assistant asks the controller for its output layout and checks which kind of controller it is. If it can't tell, you'll enter the pixel count yourself. DDP has no acknowledgement, so setup can only check that a socket opens. Nothing is sent to the lights.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the controller (UDP port 4048).

controller.title: Controller type
controller.description: Detected controller: {detected}. A vendor controller type adds a Scenes light for the controller's built-in effects and presets. Generic DDP creates only the per-output DDP lights.

data_description.controller_type: Choose Generic DDP if the detected type is wrong or you only want the DDP lights.

manual.title: Describe the strip
manual.description: The controller did not report a usable layout. One light covering the whole strip will be created.

reconfigure.title: Controller type
reconfigure.description: Detected controller: {detected}. Changing the type adds or removes the Scenes light; the DDP lights are kept.

data_description.controller_type: Generic DDP creates only the per-output DDP lights.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a UDP socket to the controller. Check the host.
error.invalid_config: The host or pixel count is not valid for DDP.

data_description.brightness_cap: Maximum output as a percent of full. Every frame is capped, including effects.
data_description.color_order: Channel order the pixels expect on the wire.
data_description.fps: Frames per second for animated effects.
data_description.keepalive: Re-send the current frame this often, in seconds, so the controller doesn't fall back to its built-in effect (the NDB-Pro does after about 20 s without DDP). 0 turns it off; otherwise at least 0.5.

controller_failed.message: Could not command the controller for {entity}: {error}

not_a_controller.message: {entity} is not a controller Scenes light; recall_preset works only on a Scenes light.

recall_preset.name: Recall preset
recall_preset.description: Plays one of the controller's 20 stored show presets (1-10 are Show 1, 11-20 Show 2). DDP segment lights are turned off so the controller's scene shows.
